targets.query:
from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with request: if exists r.request then r.request else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run =~ /^${run:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.request =~ /^${request:regex}$/)
  |> window(every: v.windowPeriod)
  |> quantile(q: ${pct:raw}, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> window(every: inf)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.run }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "p${pct:text}")

panels.title: P${pct:text} response time by request and run

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with request: if exists r.request then r.request else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run =~ /^${run:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.request =~ /^${request:regex}$/)

seconds = float(v: uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / 1000000000.0

pctResponse = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request"])
  |> quantile(q: ${pct:raw}, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " p${pct:text} response time ms", _value: r._value }))

sampleCount = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " samples", _value: float(v: r._value) }))

requestsPerSecond = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " requests/sec", _value: float(v: r._value) / seconds }))

errorRate = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "error_rate")
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " error rate", _value: r._value }))

union(tables: [pctResponse, sampleCount, requestsPerSecond, errorRate])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["request"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["request"])

base = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with request: if exists r.request then r.request else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run =~ /^${run:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.request =~ /^${request:regex}$/)

responses = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "response_code" or r._field == "response_message")
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "run", "request"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, run: r.run, request: r.request, response_code: if exists r.response_code then string(v: r.response_code) else "unknown", response_message: if exists r.response_message then string(v: r.response_message) else "unknown" }))

errorsBySample = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "error_rate")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, run: r.run, request: r.request, error_rate: float(v: r._value) }))

wide = join(tables: {responses: responses, errors: errorsBySample}, on: ["_time", "run", "request"])

samples = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, response_code: r.response_code, response_message: r.response_message, _field: r.run + " samples", _value: 1.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["request", "response_code", "response_message", "_field"])
  |> sum()

errors = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, response_code: r.response_code, response_message: r.response_message, _field: r.run + " error samples", _value: r.error_rate }))
  |> group(columns: ["request", "response_code", "response_message", "_field"])
  |> sum()

rates = wide
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, response_code: r.response_code, response_message: r.response_message, _field: r.run + " error rate", _value: r.error_rate }))
  |> group(columns: ["request", "response_code", "response_message", "_field"])
  |> mean()

union(tables: [samples, errors, rates])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["request", "response_code", "response_message"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["request", "response_code", "response_message"])

base = from(bucket: "performance")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bytes" or r._field == "sent_bytes")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with request: if exists r.request then r.request else "unknown" }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.run =~ /^${run:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.request =~ /^${request:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, run: r.run, field_name: if r._field == "bytes" then "received bytes" else "sent bytes", _value: float(v: r._value) }))

wide = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " " + r.field_name, _value: r._value }))

totals = base
  |> group(columns: ["run", "request"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ request: r.request, _field: r.run + " total bytes", _value: r._value }))

union(tables: [wide, totals])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["request"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["request"])
